# Where Economists Work

<!-- STEP id="policy" -->
Economists compare the choices, what each one costs, and what may happen next. They work in many places. In **policy-making**, they guide governments on taxes and welfare spending. In **finance**, they advise people on where to invest.

<!-- STEP id="research" -->
In **research and education**, they study economic trends and teach others. In **business consulting**, they help firms plan growth or work better. They use data from government reports and from companies' financial statements.
